title: 09 · bull_curse · The Bull's Curse
lines: Ravana once laughed at Nandi's face.
It was the most expensive joke ever told.
The king of Lanka flew his chariot over Kailash,
and it stopped in the air.
A small bull stood at the gate.
Shiva is with Parvati. No one passes.
"Shiva is with Parvati. No one passes."
Ravana looked him up and down.
A god guarded by a creature with a monkey's face?
"A god guarded by a creature with a monkey's face?"
Nandi did not charge. He did not shout.
You mock this face, he said.
Then faces like this will end your city.
"Then faces like this will end your city.
Ravana laughed harder, and flew on.
an army of monkeys crossed the sea.
And one of them set the golden city on fire,
Nandi was at his gate that night too. Still watching one thing.
The quiet ones remember. Respect the gate. That is sadhana.
